title: b7z9.22.4: C consumer for ccp_slot_map_validation.json vectors
description: Create a C ztest (lichen/tests/ccp_slot_map/) that consumes test/vectors/ccp_slot_map_validation.json (15 vectors: out-of-bounds, unsorted, boundary, empty, duplicate, all-valid). Port the slot_map validation logic to C if not already present. Rust and Python consumers exist; C is missing.
close_reason: C slot_map validator landed (spec 02a 2a.2, R-02a-008 family): lichen_slot_map_validate(slots, len, num_slots) in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c, declared in link.h — pure validator enforcing strictly-ascending entries within [0, num_slots); empty map (len 0, even NULL) is valid.
